light-cloud-com-skills-light-cloud-datab.description: Create and use Light Cloud databases (PostgreSQL or MySQL), connect them to an app through environment variables, look at tables, run SQL, check load, and change or delete a database. Use when the user wants a database for their app, asks what is in a database, wants to query or change data or the schema, or asks about environment variables or secrets on a Light Cloud app.

light-cloud-com-skills-light-cloud-deplo.description: Deploy a website, web app or API to Light Cloud and manage it afterwards (status, logs, environment variables, rollbacks, visitor passwords). Use when the user asks to build and put a site online, deploy, host or ship a project, change a live site, or check how their Light Cloud apps are doing. Works with the Light Cloud connector (remote MCP server), the local Light Cloud MCP server, or the `lc` CLI.

light-cloud-com-skills-light-cloud-domai.description: Put a Light Cloud app on the user's own domain (example.com or a subdomain like shop.example.com), tell them which DNS records to add or delete at their DNS provider, check verification, and fix a domain that isn't serving. Use when the user wants a custom domain, asks why their domain doesn't work yet, or wants to remove or change one.
